name: Deliver to MacKinley

narrative.details: Thanks again for your help, adventurer.  Here's a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum.  Take it to MacKinley and he can finally put to rest his crazy beliefs about Booty Bay booze.
narrative.objectives: Bring Stoley's Bottle to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hm, let's try this...

I can't believe it! This stuff is... terrible! That's great!

Well I guess Stoley can keep the money he owes me. He's true to his word about Steamwheedle bilge rum. That stuff is as thick as gravel and burns like lava!
narrative.requestItemsText: Did Stoley cough up my booze?
